facts.business: Zenotech Laboratories Limited is a biotechnology company that generates revenue solely from its holding company Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited through manufacturing job work at agreed conversion charges and leasing out its biotech facility and equipment.

segments.name: Manufacturing job work and facility leasing to holding company

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital Work in Progress additions during FY 2025-26

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matters: Revenue from operations (dependence on holding company Sun Pharma); Recognition of Deferred tax and tax litigations

key_risks: Complete dependence on holding company Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited for revenue
Significant tax litigations with uncertain outcomes
Recoverability of deferred tax assets dependent on future taxable income projections
Overseas subsidiaries in Brazil, USA, and Nigeria are defunct/wound up
facts.related_party_note: Material related party transactions with Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited (holding company/promoter) approved for aggregate amount not exceeding ₹200 Crore for period from 37th AGM to 38th AGM, covering manufacturing job work at agreed conversion charges and leasing of biotech facility & equipment on arm's length basis.
